item.title: Dzulkefly To Share ‘Formula’ To Fix 40% Doctor No-Shows For Permanent Posts
item.description:
Source: CodeBlue (Malaysia Health)
Health Minister Dzulkefly Ahmad says he will announce a "formula" in the near future to address the nationwide 40% medical officer no-show rate for permanent posts. The attrition rate is highest when doctors transition from contract to permanent positions. item.title: After 15 Years Of Training, This Is What A Subspecialist Doctor Earns In Malaysia — Physician
item.description:
Source: CodeBlue (Malaysia Health)
Specialist doctors in government earn RM12k-RM16k a month after 15 years of training. Subspecialists don't get extra allowances. No doctor expects to become wealthy from public service. But fairness, professional recognition, and workforce planning matter.
